2. Door hinge (slant rhyme)
3. Forage
4. Storage
5. Porridge
6. Courage
7. More inch (slant rhyme)

9. Endorsement (slant rhyme)
10. Adorned edge (slant rhyme)
11. Born edge (slant rhyme)
12. Worn edge (slant rhyme)
13. Blorenge (a hill in Wales)
14. Core range
15. Score change
16. Sporange (a rare type of fungus)
